description: Fix Batch 1 - 10 rows (Rows 15, 16, 19, 24, 28, 33, 38, 39, 40, 44) with homepage-only URLs. Research each organization's actual recruitment/vacancy/career page and update the Excel file. Working file: 'Master list - Ministries and Departments - PILOT BATCH (rows 32-42) (1).xlsx'
steps: Create a Python script that: (a) reads the PILOT BATCH Excel file, (b) for each of the 10 target rows, uses web_fetch/requests to check the organization's website for recruitment-specific pages, (c) updates columns E-M with the correct data
For Row 15 (NIUM Bengaluru, currently https://aiia.gov.in/): Find NIUM's actual website (nium.in or similar) and its recruitment/career page
For Row 16 (NIS Chennai, currently https://www.nia.nic.in/news.html): Find NIS Chennai's actual site (nischennai.org) and its recruitment page
For Row 19 (CCRUM, currently https://www.nih.nic.in/): Find CCRUM's actual site (ccrum.res.in) and its recruitment page
For Row 24 (CCH, currently https://naturopathyday.in/vac.php): Find CCH's actual site and recruitment page
For Row 28 (Dept of Fertilizers, currently https://pcimh.gov.in/...): Find fert.gov.in recruitment/vacancy page

For Row 33 (PCI, currently https://www.pci.gov.in/en/blog/?category=Announcement): Find PCI's specific recruitment/vacancy page if available, or keep announcement page if that's where vacancies are posted
For Row 38 (DGCA, currently https://www.dgca.gov.in/digigov-portal/): Research if DGCA has a specific recruitment subpage within the portal
For Row 39 (BCAS, currently https://www.bcasindia.gov.in/): Research if BCAS has a recruitment section
For Row 40 (AAIB, currently https://aaib.gov.in/): Research if AAIB has a specific recruitment page
For Row 44 (Regional Airworthiness Offices/DGCA Field Units, currently https://www.dgca.gov.in/digigov-portal/): Same as DGCA parent
Update columns E (URL), F (same URL), G ('Same Page'), H ('Yes'), I (Priority), J (descriptive notes), K (today's date), L ('No'), M ('Website' or 'Portal') for each row
Save the Excel file and verify the changes
acceptance_criteria: All 10 rows in the batch have URLs containing recruitment-specific keywords where possible
Where no dedicated recruitment page exists (e.g., single-page apps, small orgs), the notes in column J explain why the homepage/portal URL is used
The Excel file is saved correctly and can be reopened without corruption
Each URL has been verified to return HTTP 200 or confirmed to be the correct page
verification: Run the Python script and confirm it completes without errors
Re-read the Excel file and print rows 15, 16, 19, 24, 28, 33, 38, 39, 40, 44 to verify URLs are updated
Check that updated URLs contain recruitment-specific keywords where applicable
findings: Working file confirmed as PILOT BATCH file (per user steering). Main file deleted per user request. Research findings: (1) fert.gov.in times out from this environment but URL structure confirmed correct from other rows in the file. (2) DGCA and BCAS are JS-rendered SPAs with no static recruitment URLs - DGCA has a deeplink URL that triggers vacancy circular loading, BCAS has Angular vacancy-list API but no static page. (3) AAIB is a small org with recruitment PDF linked on homepage. (4) CCH has been replaced by NCH (National Commission for Homoeopathy). (5) CCRUM vacancy page uses parameter-based routing (mid=1752). (6) requests module was not pre-installed, had to pip install it.
